## Closing — all four rows resolved

Re-verified each checklist row against current code (`file:line`):

- ✅ **tool** — resolved as a *read-only projection* (the "mark the metadata read-only/derived" option, not an executor). [`tool.zod.ts:124`](../blob/main/packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts) now declares `[READ-ONLY PROJECTION — not an execution entry point]`, and the `packages/spec/liveness/tool.json` ledger carries the same WRITE-ONLY note. Landed in #3223.
- ✅ **EmailTemplateSchema** — reconciled. `plugin-email` imports the spec `EmailTemplateDefinition` type (`email-plugin.ts:13`); `upsertTemplate()` (`email-plugin.ts:426`) materializes spec-shaped templates into `sys_email_template` rows, which the runtime `TemplateLoader` reads back (`email-plugin.ts:258`). The two shapes are bridged, not divergent.
- ✅ **SharingRuleSchema** — resolved under the P0 sharing-rules issue #1887 (closed 2026-06-21); cross-listed here only.
- ✅ **spec-bridge page/dashboard bridges** — the two orphaned bridges (`bridgePage` / `bridgeDashboard`, zero runtime consumers; the dashboard bridge's pre-ADR-0021 input shape is rejected by the strict `DashboardWidgetSchema`) are **deleted** in objectstack-ai/objectui#2817 (`@object-ui/react` major, net −907). The live `list` / `form` bridges are untouched.

Closing as completed. Systemic ledger-gap follow-ups continue in their own issues: #3461 (webhook disconnect), #3462 (enroll webhook in GOVERNED — report/dashboard already enrolled via #3474), #3464 (Portal prune-or-build).

Refs #1878.
